parsed.name: PV日志记录组件
parsed.description: 用于采集并记录过程变量（PV）随时间变化数据的非物理软件组件，支持实验运行监测与追溯分析。
parsed.description_en: A non-physical software component that records time-series data of process variables (PVs) for experiment monitoring and traceability analysis.

actions.description: 读取记录配置文件，确定监测的 PV、日志路径以及采集起止时间等设置。
actions.description_en: Read the logging configuration file to determine monitored PVs, log paths, and collection start and end times.

actions.description: 创建 PV 日志文件夹，并按需要切换到该目录以保存记录数据和元数据。
actions.description_en: Create the PV log folder and optionally change into that directory to store logged data and metadata.

actions.description: 连接或重新连接配置中的 PV，并建立相应的监测对象与元数据文件。
actions.description_en: Connect or reconnect the configured PVs and create the corresponding monitored objects and metadata files.

actions.description: 将新的 PV 加入记录列表，可同时附加描述和变更阈值等信息。
actions.description_en: Add a new PV to the logging list, optionally with description and monitor deadband information.

actions.description: 检查新增 PV 请求文件，并将其中列出的 PV 动态加入监测过程。
actions.description_en: Check for a new-PV request file and dynamically add the listed PVs to the monitoring process.

actions.description: 检查停止信号，例如停止文件或到达结束时间，以决定是否终止数据采集。
actions.description_en: Check for an exit signal, such as a stop file or the configured end time, to decide whether data collection should stop.

actions.description: 结束数据记录流程并完成收尾处理。
actions.description_en: Finish the data logging process and perform final cleanup.

actions.description: 在退出时执行收尾操作，确保记录过程正确结束。
actions.description_en: Perform exit-time cleanup actions to ensure the logging process ends properly.

actions.description: 启动并运行 PV 记录主循环，在开始时间后持续采集数据，直到收到退出条件为止。
actions.description_en: Start and run the main PV logging loop, collecting data after the start time until an exit condition is reached.
